# Curemed

> Kuwait-based pharmaceuticals and medical supplies company offering trusted brands across skin, body, wellness, and home health care.

Curemed distributes pharmaceutical and medical-supply brands to consumers and pharmacies across Kuwait. The storefront lets visitors browse by brand or category, view product details, and contact the team for orders and inquiries.

## Pages

- [Home](/curemed): Featured products, brand carousel, categories.
- [About](/about): Company background and mission.
- [Contact](/contact): Phone, email, address, and contact form.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy): How customer data is handled.
- [Terms of Service](/terms-of-service): Storefront terms.

## Brands

- [Flexitol](/flexitol): Foot and skin care.
- [Kapiva](/kapiva): Ayurvedic wellness.
- [Nada](/nada): Personal care.
- [Australian Bodycare](/australian-bodycare): Tea-tree based skincare.
- [La Fe's](/lafes): Personal care.
- [Hartington](/hartington): Wellness supplements.
- [Phytophar](/phytophar): Herbal supplements.
- [Hualunhongli](/hualunhongli): Health products.
